item.title: Iron County Trail Club to host second annual Candlelight Snowshoe event
item.description: A popular snowshoeing opportunity is making a return to Iron River in a few weeks. The Iron County Trail Club is hosting its second annual Candlelight Snowshoe event on February 28, offering a free night to hit the trails with family and friends at a comfortable pace.

item.title: Whitmer budget priorities set stage for negotiations in final year as governor
item.description: Governor Gretchen Whitmer’s executive budget recommendation highlights road funding, housing expansion and student literacy. Lawmakers in a divided Legislature say negotiations will center on spending levels, tax policy and state reserves.
